title: A units library with generic math
description:
Build a small library of measurements that works for any number type and refuses to mix units.

```
Length<double> 1.5 m + 30 cm = 1.8 m
Length<decimal> 0.1 m + 0.2 m = 0.3 m (exact)
Mass + Length -> does not compile
average of [2 m, 4 m] = 3 m
```
hints: `public static Length<T> operator +(Length<T> a, Length<T> b) => new(a.Metres + b.Metres);` (lesson 8.03).
A different struct for `Mass<T>` is all it takes for the compiler to refuse `mass + length`.
requirements: `readonly record struct Length<T>(T Metres) where T : INumber<T>` with `+`, `-`, `*` by a number and comparison.
A generic `Average<TQuantity>` that works for any quantity type implementing `IAdditionOperators` and an interface of your own with a `static abstract` `Zero` and a division by a count.
stretch: Add `ToString(string unit)` that prints in cm, m or km.
